method: Candidate policy fields were curated from the official candidate-supplied 2026 pamphlet statements and previously prepared source-attributed summaries; no party affiliation inference. Every issue asked of one candidate is also asked of every other candidate in the same contest. Blank positions are not filled by invention. Selected forum statements and official final-passage voting records have been added where they bear directly on an issue; those cells are labeled by source type rather than presented as equivalent evidence.

standards.scope: Issue-by-issue comparison of topics raised by either person and relevant to the office. Not a promise of all possible policy stances.
standards.stated: Candidate stated priority, proposal, or description from cited pamphlet. This does not establish that the promise will happen.
standards.not_found: No explicit position found in the materials reviewed for this issue. This does not mean support, opposition, or no opinion.
standards.judicial: Judges should be evaluated on legal work and approach to applying law, not forced into pledges about cases that may come before them.
